name: moc_drift_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: In the 14:30–15:20 IST window, NIFTY experiences systematic directional drift driven by ETF rebalancers, passive-fund TWAP algos, and institutional MOC programs that are pre-committed to executing at or near the close price. When NIFTY has sustained above session VWAP and is up since 14:00 — indicating net afternoon buying pressure — these pre-committed buy programs create 15–30 second momentum bursts as they absorb resting sell liquidity in the order book faster than new sellers replenish it. At 5-second resolution, a 1-minute momentum confirmation (close > 60 seconds ago) signals that an active burst is underway; entering in that direction captures the tail of the institutional flow before it exhausts.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no scaling, it is an anchored measure. A sustained VWAP premium signals that net buy flow has dominated all day, making MOC buy-program activity more likely.

indicators.name: vwap_dev
indicators.purpose: % deviation from VWAP. Threshold ~0.10% on NIFTY (roughly 20-25 spot points at 24000 level) separates noise from genuine afternoon accumulation. Smaller than stock threshold because index mean-reverts faster.

indicators.name: return_since_1400
indicators.purpose: Afternoon momentum anchored at 14:00. This is a FIXED-TIME anchor, not a rolling window — scaled from original which also used 14:00. Positive reading means buying pressure sustained for 30+ minutes, corroborating that MOC programs will be net buyers.

indicators.name: momentum_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute momentum (12 × 5s bars). This is the ENTRY TRIGGER — detects that a burst is actively underway. 12 bars chosen because MOC-driven NIFTY bursts typically last 30–90 seconds; confirming at 60s lookback means we are catching an active burst rather than a stale one. Shorter (6 bars) catches noise; longer (24 bars) misses the entry.

buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions true simultaneously at a 5s bar close

buy_pe.confirmation: All three conditions true simultaneously at a 5s bar close

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts corresponds to ~8 NIFTY spot points. A 30-second MOC drift burst should not retrace 8 pts if the thesis is correct — that would mean the institutional flow has reversed, not just paused. At delta ~0.5, 8 spot pts = 4 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot points. A 30–60 second institutional-flow burst in the final hour typically covers 10–15 spot pts before stalling. Capturing 12 pts (80th percentile of 30s move) gives 1:1.5 R:R. With 55% expected win rate, this yields positive expectancy.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 15:20 IST (920 min) — no new entries after 15:20; EOD flatten handles residual

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — above 22 the end-of-day auction dynamics change (panic selling overrides MOC programs)
filters.time_filter: entry only in 14:30–15:20 IST window; strategy inactive outside this window
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume filter is noisy at 5s
filters.trend_filter: return_since_1400 aligns with vwap_dev direction (both conditions required)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders at close price

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — NSE may tighten close auction mechanics over time; ETF AUM growth could make the effect stronger short-term but more crowded long-term

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual NIFTY50 stocks using stock-level volume_ratio to identify which stocks had large MOC imbalances. Converted to NIFTY index by: (1) replacing stock volume ratio with 3-condition index filter (VWAP dev + afternoon return + 1-min momentum), (2) compressing hold from 40-55 minutes to 30-90 seconds with time_stop_bars=18, (3) replacing stock-specific close_vs_vwap with index VWAP deviation. The nifty_return_since_1400 filter in the original is now the primary signal — the index IS the instrument. Original's entry_at_14:45 window is expanded to the full 14:30-15:20 range because at 5s bars each entry is independent.
weaknesses: NIFTY index MOC drift is weaker than individual stock MOC imbalances — stocks with outsized index-weight rebalancing flow are more predictable than the aggregate index.
False signals during the 14:30-15:20 window on expiry days when gamma unwind dominates over MOC flow.
All three conditions firing simultaneously may be too rare — low trade frequency (0-4/day) requires multi-week testing to reach statistical significance.
Compressing from 55-minute hold to 90-second hold fundamentally changes the risk: original captured full drift; this captures only first micro-burst.
